meta.title: MCP Studio · MCP Service Manager
meta.description: Manage MCP services in DSH Settings. Connect remote HTTP and local stdio servers, import JSON configuration, configure Bearer tokens or custom authentication headers, test connections, inspect tool schemas, run tools manually, browse resources, and grant Agent access per tool. Connection settings persist, credentials use the host credential service, and access grants remain separate from connection state.

ui.title: MCP services
ui.intro: Browse MCP sources, manage Studio connections, and inspect configured tools.
ui.searchTools: Search tools by name or purpose…
ui.boundary: Manage connections and Agent grants for Studio services. Configuration sources are read-only and remain managed by their original plugins.
ui.emptyServersHelp: Add a remote URL to discover your first tools.
ui.selectService: Select a service to view its capabilities.

ui.manualNote: Manual tests do not change Agent permissions. Tool calls can change external data.
ui.removeHelp: The connection and its stored credentials will be removed. This cannot be undone.
